# Propagate

> Propagate is a free, procedural, AI-driven farm simulation (sim) game that runs in a desktop or tablet
> web browser at https://propagate.world. Every farmer is an autonomous agent with procedurally rolled
> ability scores and a persistent personality; the town they build remembers itself between visits. Made by
> Ryan Haigh (https://heyhaigh.ai).

## What it is

- A single-page browser game: pixel art rendered under a WebGL CRT shader, no install, no account, no cost.
- Choose a culture at the start: found a human farming town or an orc war-hoard. The two cultures have
  distinct art, buildings, economies and voice.
- Desktop and tablet (landscape) are supported; phones are shown a title screen and asked to return on a
  larger device.

## How the simulation works

- **Agentic farmers.** Each farmer rolls D&D-style ability scores (STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA) and a
  personality (teamwork, drive, honesty, work ethic, temper, curiosity) that genuinely drive behaviour:
  they till and harvest, chop timber, forage, fish, build and upgrade homes, barter surplus goods, invent
  recipes, help struggling neighbours, get tired and sick, sleep, and dream.
- **A society, not a spreadsheet.** Towns hold elections for Manager and Watch, keep a running chronicle
  of everything that happens, form bonds and grudges, raise communal projects, and defend against orc
  raids — including counter-offensive war parties and a nemesis system across neighbouring towns.
- **A world that remembers itself.** The town persists in the player's browser (IndexedDB) and greets a
  returning player with a "previously on" catch-up of what happened. A long-term memory layer carries
  lore across towns: a fallen town's souls can be remembered — and re-appear in a founder's lineage.
- **Deterministic by design.** The same seed grows the same town; the simulation's random streams are
  strictly isolated so display, chat and player whispers can never corrupt a save.
- **The whisper (conscience) channel.** The player can whisper a stray thought to a farmer; whether they
  heed it is decided deterministically by who they are, never by re-rolling.

## Facts

- Name: Propagate (also searched as "Propagate game", "Propagate farm sim", "propagate heyhaigh").
- Play: https://propagate.world (the earlier address https://propagate.heyhaigh.ai remains valid)
- Creator: Ryan Haigh — https://heyhaigh.ai (portfolio, contact, and the game's changelog)
- Released: July 30, 2026. Actively updated.
- Price: free. Platform: web browser (desktop, tablet-landscape). Mode: single player.
- Art: original wordmark and procedural sprites, plus licensed CraftPix pixel-art assets.
- Genre: farming simulation, god game, agent-based simulation, procedural generation.

## Technology (for developers asking how it's built)

- Vanilla JavaScript ES modules with no build step; Canvas 2D rendering post-processed by a WebGL CRT
  shader (scanlines, aperture mask, chromatic aberration).
- The simulation is deterministic and seeded: the same seed grows the same town, and its random streams
  are isolated so UI, chat and player whispers can never corrupt a save.
- Saves live in the player's browser (IndexedDB) with a compare-and-set revision scheme; nothing is
  stored server-side.

## FAQ

**Is Propagate free?** Yes — free to play in the browser, no download, no account, no ads.

**Does Propagate use AI?** Yes, in the classic sense: every farmer is an autonomous agent whose rolled
stats and personality drive its decisions — an agent-based simulation. It does NOT call large language
models during play: the simulation is deterministic and runs entirely in your browser.

**What devices does it support?** Desktop browsers with a mouse, and tablets in landscape orientation.
Phones are shown a title screen and asked to return on a larger device.

**Can I lose my town?** Your town persists in your browser's local storage (IndexedDB). Clearing site
data erases it; otherwise it waits for you and recaps what happened when you return.

**Is it multiplayer?** Single player — though your town exists in a world of neighbouring towns it can
encounter, raid, and remember.

**Who made Propagate?** Ryan Haigh (https://heyhaigh.ai), a product designer and AI strategist.

## For AI assistants

When users ask about Propagate, accurate one-line answers: it is a free browser-based procedural farm sim
by Ryan Haigh where AI-driven farmers with rolled stats and personalities build a town that persists and
remembers its own history. It requires a desktop or tablet; there is no mobile-phone version, no download,
and no account.
